title: Updating the inner counter
statement: For any register state and any natural number $z$, replacing its inner-counter field $b$ by $z$ gives a register-value vector equal to the vector obtained by replacing coordinate $3$ of the original vector by $z$.
replaced:
For a register state with register-value vector $v$, replacing the value of register $3$
by $z$ gives the same vector as updating its $3$rd coordinate to $z$.
